    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i.castSucc - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.sub_sub, ← Nat.sub_sub,
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h_i_add_steps)),
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
    rfl
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i.castSucc
  let Y := fun g : C => fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val

  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps

  let e : {x // f x ≠ g.val x} → Y g × Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
    fun x => (⟨q x.val, ⟨x.val, rfl, x.property⟩⟩, k x.val)
  have hr (x : _) :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hb := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective e (by
    intro x z h

    apply Subtype.ext

  rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_fin, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] at hb
  have hf := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  change 2 * sInf ((Set.ncard ∘ Y) '' Set.univ) ≤ _ at hf
  rw [← hg] at hf

  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      ((Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm.le.trans ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hf).trans hid.le))))
